texts.academy_hint: Isomo rigufi rifunguka iruhande rwa ecran ryigisha.
texts.auto_negative_stock_flag: Erekana ububiko buri munsi ya zeru
texts.auto_reorder_one_tap: Ongera utumize ukanze rimwe ku watanze ibicuruzwa uheruka
texts.automations_intro: Buri gikorwa cyikora kiri hano n'icyo gikora, urwego rwacyo n'akabuto ko kuzimya. Nta na kimwe cyimura amafaranga, gihindura ijambobanga cyangwa kirenga urwego rwacyo.
texts.ch_help: Subiza ukoresheje umubare. Ku butumwa bugufi: 1, igicuruzwa, ingano na PIN kugira ngo ugurishe; 2 ku by'uyu munsi; 3 ku bubiko.
texts.ch_pin: Gurisha {qty} {name}. Andika PIN yawe kugira ngo wemeze:
texts.data_sharing_body: Utanga ibicuruzwa abona uko ibicuruzwa bye bigurishwa mu iduka ryawe ari uko wahisemo kubisangiza. Uruhushya rumwe kuri buri utanga ibicuruzwa, ushobora kurukuraho igihe icyo ari cyo cyose. Amakuru yawe ntagurishwa na rimwe.
texts.day_close_body: Igurisha {sales}, {total}. Amafaranga ategerejwe mu isanduku {cash}. Byemejwe {confirmed}, bitegereje {waiting}.
texts.details_secure: Amakuru yerekanwa n'uyitanga ufite uruhushya nyuma y'igenzura rishya, mu gihe gito, ntibibe nta murandasi.
texts.difference_flagged: Itandukaniro ryanditswe kuri nyiri ubucuruzi. Nta kintu gihagarikwa.
texts.event_log: Urutonde rw'ibyabaye (ibyo igikoresho cyohereza n'ibyo igicu gisubiza)
texts.failed_try_again: Umufatanyabikorwa yanze. Nta kintu cyafashwe. Gerageza ubundi buryo.
texts.float_forecast: Hasigaye iminsi nka {days} y'amafaranga y'ibikorwa ukurikije umuvuduko usanzwe (igereranya)
texts.float_read_live: Asomwa ako kanya ku mufatanyabikorwa. LynkOmni ntibika amafaranga yawe y'ibikorwa.
texts.freeze_requested: Guhagarika byasabwe. Igaragazwa ko ihagaritswe ari uko uyitanga abyemeje.
texts.group_reached: Intego yagezweho. Buri duka ryishyura utanga ibicuruzwa umugabane waryo.
texts.internet_help: Kuraho akamenyetso ukore nta murandasi: ibyakozwe bibikwa ku murongo bikoherezwa nyuma. Serivisi z'umukozi, izo kwakira amafaranga n'iz'abafatanyabikorwa ntizitangira nta murandasi.
texts.joined: Winjiye. Wishyura utanga ibicuruzwa umugabane wawe gusa itsinda nirigera ku ntego.
texts.laptop_note: Ibi ni ibyo nyiri ubucuruzi abona muri mushakisha. Kugurisha n'amafaranga mu ntoki bikora gusa ku gikoresho cyanditswe.
texts.locale_card: Igihugu, ururimi, ifaranga n'isaha bituruka ku ipaki y'igihugu cyawe. Hindura icyo ari cyo cyose ukanze rimwe.
texts.locked_idle: Byafunzwe nyuma y'iminota ibiri nta gukorwaho
texts.low_float: Amafaranga y'ibikorwa make: ongeramo unyuze ku mufatanyabikorwa
texts.mesh_no_money: LynkMesh itwara amakuru, ntitwara amafaranga, kandi ntigira amafaranga y'ikiguzi. B ntishobora gusoma cyangwa guhindura ibyo itwara.
texts.mesh_relay: Byoherejwe binyuze ku gikoresho kiri hafi, bitegereje igicu
texts.needs_registered_device: Kugurisha, amafaranga mu ntoki, imyanya y'akazi na serivisi z'umukozi bikora gusa ku gikoresho cyanditswe ku bucuruzi.
texts.negative_stock: Munsi ya zeru: bara iki gicuruzwa
texts.never_before_confirmed: Ntuzigere utanga amafaranga mbere y'uko umufatanyabikorwa yemeza.
texts.new_order_test: Ohereza itumiza ry'igerageza uvuye ku isanduku
texts.not_proof: Ubutumwa bugufi cyangwa ifoto ya ecran si gihamya cyo kwishyura. Byemejwe gusa nibyo bibarwa.
texts.nothing_understood: Nta gihuye. Ongera ugerageze cyangwa ukande ku bicuruzwa.
texts.online_only: Serivisi z'umukozi, izo kwakira amafaranga n'iz'abafatanyabikorwa zikenera umuyoboro. Nta kintu gishyirwa ku murongo.
texts.order_qr: Tumiza kandi wishyure ku meza ukoresheje QR
texts.placeholder_limits: Imbibi n'ibiciro ni iby'agateganyo kugeza uyitanga asinye.
texts.practice_mode_help: Kopi yo kwitoza, igaragara neza. Nta na kimwe yandika ari ukuri kandi nta na kimwe gihuzwa.
texts.printed_tickets: Kuri iyi gahunda amatike y'igikoni arasohorwa ku mpapuro
texts.proof_photo: Gihamya: ifoto y'ipaki (ntibe iy'umuntu na rimwe)
texts.provider_declines_help: Umufatanyabikorwa w'igerageza asubiza Byanze aho kuba Byemejwe.
texts.real_user_help: Yerekana igihugu wahisemo uko umucuruzi waho akibona uyu munsi: hakora gusa ibyo umufatanyabikorwa ufite uruhushya n'amasezerano yasinywe akora; ibindi byerekana "Biraza mu gihugu cyawe vuba".
texts.referred: Byoherejwe ku mufatanyabikorwa. Umufatanyabikorwa ni we ufata icyemezo akabimenyesha umukiriya.
texts.relay_body: Iki gikoresho nta muyoboro gifite. Igikoresho cya LynkOmni kiri hafi gitwara ipaki ifunze kikayigeza ku gicu. Nta kigaragazwa nk'icyakiriwe kugeza igicu kicyakiriye.
texts.sandbox_note: Amakuru y'icyitegererezo, abafatanyabikorwa b'igerageza, amafaranga y'igerageza gusa. Ntiharasuzumwa n'umuhanzi w'ishusho.
texts.second_currency: Hafi {amount} (igereranya ku gaciro k'uyu munsi; igurisha rigumana {currency})
texts.setup_done_in: Gutegura munsi y'iminota ibiri. Igurisha rya mbere mu munota umwe.
texts.shop_qr_help: Abakiriya basikana iyi kode bagafungura urupapuro rw'iduka ryawe bakishyura.
texts.start_group_pro: Gutangiza itsinda bisaba Pro cyangwa Max.
texts.tamper_test: Igerageza: B ihindura ipaki mu nzira
texts.tips_belong: Agashimwe ni ak'ubucuruzi. LynkOmni nta mugabane ifata.
texts.voice_hint: Vuga ibicuruzwa, urugero «imifuka ibiri y'umuceri, isabune imwe». Wemeza mbere y'uko igurisha ribikwa.
texts.why_cash_difference_flag: Ibarura ry'amafaranga ryatandukanye n'ibyari bitegerejwe. Nta kintu cyahagaritswe.
texts.why_chat_routing: Ubutumwa bwagiye ku muntu ukurikirana ibibazo by'ubu bwoko.
texts.why_chat_suggested_replies: Umukiriya yanditse; ibisubizo byatanzwe mu rurimi rwe kugira ngo umuntu ahitemo.
texts.why_chat_summary: Wasabye incamake; imibare iguma igaragara kandi incamake ifite akamenyetso.
texts.why_commission_match: Raporo y'umufatanyabikorwa yageze ihuzwa umurongo ku wundi; buri tandukaniro ryerekanywe.
texts.why_day_close_prepare: Igihe cyo gufunga: igurisha, amafaranga ategerejwe mu isanduku, ibicuruzwa bigiye gushira n'ikidasanzwe cyose, mu butumwa bumwe.
texts.why_delivery_auto_request: Itegeko ryawe ryateguye umufatanyabikorwa uhendutse ku itumiza ryishyuwe. Ushobora kubisubiza uko byari biri mu minota itanu.
texts.why_device_health: Igikoresho cyanditswe gifite porogaramu ishaje, bateri nke, umwanya muto cyangwa kimaze iminsi kitagaragara.
texts.why_expiry_alert: Igice kirangira iki cyumweru; igabanuka cyangwa kukijugunya byateguwe.
texts.why_kitchen_routing: Itumiza ry'ameza ryageze kuri ecran y'igikoni, cyangwa kuri printeri kuri gahunda y'Ubuntu.
texts.why_low_float_warning: Amafaranga yawe y'ibikorwa ku mufatanyabikorwa yamanutse munsi ya kimwe cya gatanu cy'umunsi usanzwe.
texts.why_low_stock_reorder: Ububiko bwageze ku rwego rwo kongera gutumiza; igura ryateguwe ngo uryemeze.
texts.why_negative_stock_flag: Igurisha nta murandasi ryashyize ububiko munsi ya zeru. Igurisha ntiryigeze rihagarikwa; bara igicuruzwa.
texts.why_product_from_photo: Wafashe ifoto; LynkAssist yateguye izina, igiciro n'icyiciro. Nta kibikwa utaremeza.
texts.why_receipt_delivery: Inyemezabuguzi yoherejwe ku muyoboro umukiriya yahisemo, mu rwego rwa gahunda yawe.
texts.why_reorder_one_tap: Wigeze kwakira iki gicuruzwa; gukanda rimwe biragitumiza ku watanze ibicuruzwa umwe nyuma yo kwemeza.
texts.why_setup_autofill: Ubucuruzi bwashyizweho; LynkAssist yateguye umwirondoro wabwo uhereye ku ipaki y'igihugu kugira ngo uwemeze.
texts.why_shift_reminder: Umwanya w'akazi utangira mu isaha imwe.
texts.why_staff_pin_lock: Iminota ibiri nta gukorwaho; ifunga rya PIN y'abakozi ryatangiye.
texts.why_sync_retry: Umuyoboro wagarutse; igurisha n'ubwishyu byoherejwe mbere, amashusho nyuma.
